title: Grounded snippet — return_policy
text: Return policy excerpt used for RAG evaluation: Customers may return most new, unused items within 30 days of delivery with original packaging and proof of purchase. Final-sale and personalised goods are excluded. Refunds post to the original payment method after inspection.

title: Grounded snippet — order_management
text: Order management guidance: Customers can cancel an unshipped order from Order History. Once a parcel is in transit, cancellation converts to a refusal-on-delivery or return after receipt. Always confirm order ID before applying changes.
